svg.title: gs-vision architecture and one-search flow
svg.desc: The gs-vision search processes and their connections to ACT-R productions. Blue solid arrows show the search request and successful result, rust dashed arrows show failure, gray dotted arrows show trial feedback, and gray solid arrows connect module processes.
